source.name: TUBELEX Spanish default word frequencies
source.limitations: YouTube subtitle proxy for spoken exposure, not a representative conversation corpus. Lowercased surface-form counts, not sense/person/tense-disambiguated frequencies. Candidate lists use present forms only; other tenses follow grammatical consistency, not measured rankings. Examples are original authored sentences, not corpus quotations.
